title: Merge queue
description: A merged PR receives an atomic item-owned merge receipt and landing stamps before the holder is notified. Worker closeout still owns results and verification. A queue entry marked UNMERGEABLE stops the landing once GitHub decides its mergeability, even before GitHub removes it; while GitHub still reports mergeable as unknown, the landing stays pending and no notice goes out. An open PR whose merge state GitHub reports as unknown is also still pending: GitHub reports unknown while it recomputes, including mid-merge after it clears the queue entry and merge-when-ready. An open CLEAN PR with arming cleared and no queue entry is re-read once after three seconds before a stopped notice; a merge on that read receives the completion notice, while persistent absence still stops. A conflicting entry's notice names rebase onto the base, verification, and governed merge re-entry. A mergeable entry needs no holder action: the landing observer re-enqueues the unchanged head by itself, and a hold would switch that recovery off. Queue CI evidence uses the merge gate's registered full command, falling back to quick. Missing executable commands stop close-out without an unchanged retry; recovery names yoke qa registered-command set. Source-observed; deployed proof is pending. Arming, disarming and dequeuing request Contents write and Pull requests write on installation tokens; an operator hold still requires bound user authority by policy.
